father_game_night_greeting_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, perfect timing! We've got the whole family together, and I've been looking forward to this all evening. Come on, grab a seat!

father_game_night_finish_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Well, that was quite the evening! Some very clever moves all around, I must say. I think I'll need a little practice before our next game night!

father_house_party_greeting_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Oh, wonderful! Everyone's arriving, and the house is looking absolutely splendid. I do hope you've brought your appetite, kiddo. Your Other Mother has been cooking all day!

father_house_party_social_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: I've been having the most interesting conversations this evening! Well, I think they were interesting. There was rather a lot going on.

father_house_party_game_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, a little friendly competition! Nothing like a good board game to bring people together. Though I do hope nobody gets too competitive.

father_house_party_feast_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Mmm! This is marvelous! I was beginning to think we'd never get to eat. Though I suppose that's what happens when you invite the whole neighborhood!

father_house_party_finish_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, what a splendid party! I don't think I've talked that much in ages. I may need a nice quiet evening at the piano after all this!

father_player_party_greeting_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Oh, wonderful! The guest of honor! Welcome to your very own party, kiddo. I must say, the whole house is looking rather splendid!

father_player_party_social_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: I've been talking to all sorts of wonderful people tonight. Mind you, I seem to have forgotten half their names already. Ha!

father_player_party_entertainment_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Oh, there are some marvelous surprises tucked away around the house tonight. Your Other Mother really has outdone herself.

father_player_party_celebration_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Well, would you look at that cake! Absolutely magnificent! And so many presents, too. I think you've got quite a bit of unwrapping ahead of you!

father_player_party_finish_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, what a wonderful party! Lovely people, marvelous entertainment, and that cake was absolutely delicious. We really ought to do this again!

father_player_party_finish_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Well, kiddo, I hope you've enjoyed yourself! It's not every day you get a celebration quite like this one. Your Other Mother certainly knows how to make things special.

father_mother_goes_out_mother_left_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, your Other Mother has popped out, has she? Well, she's always got a hundred little things to attend to. Don't mind me, kiddo. I'll be at the piano if you need anything.

father_mother_goes_out_mother_left_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Oh, she's gone out for a while? Yes, she does that from time to time. I couldn't tell you exactly where she goes, though. She rather likes to keep certain things to herself.

father_mother_goes_out_when_return_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: When will she be back? Oh, goodness, I haven't the faintest idea! She tends to return whenever she's finished whatever it is she's doing. Best not to worry about it.

father_mother_goes_out_when_return_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, well, your Other Mother can be rather unpredictable about these things. Sometimes she's back before I've even finished a piece of music. Other times, I have time to play the whole thing twice!
